customer.market: Round Rock / Central Texas (serves statewide on TX criminal matters)
customer.business_model: professional legal service (criminal defense, DWI), consultation/enquiry conversion

golden_evidence_cards.direct_observation: Criminal Defense page states coverage (misdemeanor+felony, TX state and federal) and describes case preparation (discovery, witness interviews, motion practice), and mentions 'Flat fees for most matters' and 'payment plans available', but does not list any case results, outcomes, or testimonials as proof, and does not answer what to do immediately after an arrest or how long a case typically takes.
golden_evidence_cards.buyer_question: Will a criminal defense lawyer actually take my case, what does it cost, and what are my first steps after an arrest?
golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: Criminal defense page has no visible case results/proof, no after-arrest first-steps guide, and only vague 'flat fees for most matters' without guidance on how to reach the free consultation from this page.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: A person arrested faces anxiety and urgency; the criminal defense page stops at coverage+prep and does not convert hesitancy into action, so a worried prospect leaves without booking the free consultation, suppressing the engagement enquiries that drive the goal (more leads for the firm).
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add an 'Immediate Next Steps After an Arrest' block and a prominent 'Free Case Evaluation' CTA with a phone+form high-light, plus a short 'No upfront fee for the initial consultation' trust line on the criminal-defense page.
golden_evidence_cards.evidence: Direct page read on 2026-09-13 (heading 'Criminal Defense'; flat-fee + payment-plan text present; no results/testimonials; CTA is generic nav 'Free Consultation').

golden_evidence_cards.direct_observation: Contact page has a form (fields: name, email, practice, subject, message) with 'Free Consultation' and 'Contact Us' CTA text, and hours 'Monday-Friday 9:00 AM-6:00 PM CT', but gives no statement of what happens after submission (response time, next step, whether the consultation is confidential/free), and no proof of past work from this page.
golden_evidence_cards.buyer_question: After I submit this form, what happens next, when will someone respond, and is the initial consultation really free and confidential?
golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: Contact form collects details but sets no post-submission expectation, response-time, confidentiality or free-consultation confirmation, so a hesitant prospect may not trust the form or may expect a slow/no reply.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: Post-submission expectation and trust are decision-stage blockers for an anxious new client; a form with no response-time and no free/confidential confirmation suppresses form completions, directly limiting the engagement enquiries that drive more leads.
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add a 3-step 'What happens next' under the form (1 review request, 2 call back within stated time, 3 confidential free evaluation) plus a 'Free & confidential initial consultation' trust line.
golden_evidence_cards.evidence: Direct page read on 2026-09-13 (form fields name/email/practice/subject/message; 'Free Consultation'; hours; no post-submission expectation or confidentiality statement).

golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: Hub lists areas but gives no decision aid mapping a situation/charge to the right practice page, so a prospect cannot self-route and may leave instead of drilling into a matching practice page.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: A prospect with an ambiguous charge needs a self-routing aid; without one they cannot confirm the firm handles their matter, reducing the progression from hub to the relevant practice page to the free consultation, suppressing leads.
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add a 'Which practice area applies to my situation?' selection aid with charge/situation questions routing to the matching practice page, plus a final route to the free consultation.

golden_evidence_cards.page_heading: What To Do After an Arrest in Texas: A Step by Step Guide
golden_evidence_cards.direct_observation: Blog post educates on what to do after a Texas arrest, but does not clearly route a reader to the firm's free consultation CTA from within the body, and does not include a 'Do NOT do this' or 'choose a lawyer' reference from this page — the educational trust asset does not convert to a contact.
golden_evidence_cards.buyer_question: I've been arrested or someone I know has — what do I do now, and should I talk to this firm?
golden_evidence_cards.specific_gap: Educational article builds authority but has no strong in-body route to the free consultation or phone, so a reader leaves informed but not converted into an enquiry.
golden_evidence_cards.business_mechanism: Educational content earns trust but only converts if the reader is guided to act; a post with no prominent consultation/phone CTA loses high-intent readers, leaving leads on the table versus the conversion the goal needs.
golden_evidence_cards.recommended_module: Add a contextually placed 'Free Confidential Consultation' CTA (phone + form link) mid-article and a 'When to talk to a lawyer' callout, plus a 'Top mistakes to avoid' list.
golden_evidence_cards.evidence: Direct page read on 2026-09-13 (heading 'What To Do After an Arrest...'; educational body; no prominent in-body contact/consultation CTA).
